name: Keys
overview: Scripture presents keys as symbols of authority and access, both physical and spiritual. In Isaiah 22:22, the key of the house of David signifies sovereign control to open and shut, a theme echoed in Matthew 16:19 where Jesus grants the keys of the kingdom of heaven, empowering binding and loosing on earth and in heaven. The keys also represent knowledge and judgment, as seen in Luke 11:52 where the key of knowledge is taken away, and in Revelation 1:18 where Christ holds the keys of death and hell, affirming His ultimate authority over life and death. These verses collectively highlight that keys in the Bible signify divine authority to govern, grant access, and execute judgment.
